npcs.name: Elder Rosa
lines: Nobody survives this place alone, friend. Nobody survives ANY place alone.
The dungeon belongs to everyone who works it. Same as the world upstairs.
Those skeletons? Middle managers who never logged off. Don't end up like them.
Freedom isn't a market. It's a promise we keep to each other.
They call it 'human resources.' We call it 'people.' Words matter down here.
Rest at the fire. It's free. The best things are.

npcs.name: Doc Debs
lines: Healing is free at my table. Imagine that — a world where it always is.
Medicare for all! Even adventurers. ESPECIALLY adventurers.
I don't bill. I bandage. There's a difference the surface forgot.
The trolls upstairs charge 4000 gold for an ambulance ride. Down here? Sit. Rest. Heal.
Your health is not a subscription service, comrade.
While there is a lower class, I am in it. While there is a soul in prison, I am not free.

npcs.name: Professor Quill
lines: Free education would've kept half these skeletons from selling their souls for equity.
I teach anyone who sits down. No tuition. No debt mites at MY door.
Knowledge hoarded is knowledge rotted. Ask any lich.
They put paywalls on papers written with public money. Villainy has many forms.
Every spell I know, I'll teach you for free. That's what a spell IS — shared knowledge.
Study the boss's patterns. Study ALL bosses' patterns. That's praxis.

npcs.name: Bard of the Commons
lines: ♪ No more wars for the surface lords, no more blood for gold... ♪
Every song I write is public domain the second I sing it. Culture is a commons!
The goblins DMCA'd my last ballad. I wrote three more about them.
♪ Solidarity forever, the dungeon makes us strong ♪
Music was never meant to be streamed at $0.003 a play, friend.
They can't evict a melody.

npcs.name: Coop the Quartermaster
lines: Welcome to the co-op! Prices cover costs, not yachts.
Every purchase funds the free clinic upstairs. Well. Downstairs. Directions are hard here.
At-cost gear for the people. The troll marks up 900%. I mark up 0%.
Take what you need, pay what it's worth. Novel concept, I know.
The workers own this shop. All one of me.

npcs.name: Old Marcher Miri
lines: I fought in three surface wars before I realized who they were really for.
No more wars. Not for oil, not for gold, not for dungeon mineral rights.
The generals never bled. The shareholders never bled. We bled.
Down here we settle things at the campfire, with soup.
Peace isn't weakness. Peace is the hardest thing we ever organized.
